d:
Blessings of An'she, child.
We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.
You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of adventurer's Rise.
You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
